conclusion: Under the prospectively frozen peer-aligned contract, both existing non-byte-exact GGUF GDN routes fail KL <= 0.05 while passing aggregate top-1 >= 90% and decode non-regression. Normalized-Q/K K2 reaches KL max 0.059031 and 445/450 top-1; raw-Q/K-plus-scale register-resident wave32 tree reaches KL max 0.068757 and 443/450 top-1. Exact state and free-running trajectory differences are diagnostic only and do not cause either rejection. Neither route proceeds to a speed or default-promotion gate.
